[ REPUBLIC ACT NO. 11790)

AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN EXTENSION OFFICE
OF THE REGIONAL LAND TRANSPORTATION
FRANCHISING AND REGULATORY BOARD IN
PUERTO PRINCESA CITY, PROVINCE OF PALAWAN
AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR

Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the
Philippines in Congress assembled:

SECTION 1. Thereis hereby established an extension office
under the supervision of the Regional Land Transportation
Franchising and Regulatory Board Region IV in Puerto Princesa
City, Province of Palawan.
 
’

SEc. 2. The Land Transportation Franchising and
Regulatory Board Regional Office, in coordination with the City
Government of Puerto Princesa and the Provincial Government
of Palawan, is hereby authorized to assist in the establishment
and maintenance of such facilities and equipment as may be
necessary to implement the intents and purpose of this Act. For
this purpose, the Regional Land Transportation Franchising and
Regulatory Board Region IV shall formulate such operating
guidelines as shall be recommended by the Department of
Transportation for proper implementation of the prescribed rules
and regulations governing proceedings with any aspect involving
public land transportation services in the Province of Palawan.

SEc. 3. The Secretary of Transportation shall include in
the Department’s program the funding requirements for the
establishment and operationalization of the extension office of the
Regional Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board
Office in the Province of Palawan.

Sec. 4. This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after
its publication ih the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of
general circulation.

Approved,

 

of Representatives
